label: Structured shared-IO feature process - sparse randomized ~1h sequential episodes including zero-return seconds - K1 1s input x 59 - K2 1s output x 59 - W256 - M128 - P128 - F128 - PF256 - NF256 - standardized next-feature MSE - 256k clean - batch 10240 train and evaluation - no regularization - weight EMA 4 epochs

architecture.numberedLayerSharing: each parenthesized number in the diagram is one exact GNGLU module instance reused at every matching input/output block
architecture.initialState: the first observed W embedding seeds M and P with two unnumbered GNGLUs; shared layer 3 produces F and shared layer 4 produces PF
architecture.outputState: shared layer 7 maps PF to NF; shared layer 8 maps NF to expected W; shared layer 2 decodes W to the complete next-second O-feature state
architecture.latentSemantics: P, F, PF, and NF remain unconstrained latent embeddings in this experiment; no probability decoder or density loss is imposed

loss.description: mean MSE over every predicted output step and all 59 feature channels after per-feature training-split standardization

sampling.description: complete consecutive 1s rows in approximately one-hour episodes, with randomized episode placement spread across each chronological split
sampling.comparisonControl: architecture, optimizer, loss, example counts, batches, and EMA match the prior dense-origin run

alignment.input: timeline row at each selected episode origin (the immediately preceding completed 1s 59-channel state)
alignment.target: the complete chronological timeline row at origin+1 (the next completed 1s 59-channel state)
alignment.futureExtension: K1 uses consecutive rows ending at origin; K2 uses consecutive rows starting at origin+1
